newsitem.title: USA: Dart Group reaches settlement with Hafts.
newsitem.headline: Dart Group reaches settlement with Hafts.

text.p: Dart Group Corp said it has reached a settlement with the Haft family, which founded the company.
The settlement with Robert, Gloria and Linda Haft has been approved by the Executive Committee of Dart's board of directors, is subject to approval by the full board by September 2, the company said.

Dart also said that it is continuing its settlement negotiations with Herbert Haft, the founder and present chairman and chief executive. The company said it anticipates executing a comprehensive settlement agreement with him by September 2.

The settlement with Robert, Gloria and Linda Haft includes: the purchase by Dart from them of 104,976 shares of Class B common stock and 81,556 shares of Class A common stock; the termination of options held or claimed by them to purchase a total of 283,750 shares of Class A common stock; and the termination of a small number of options to purchase shares of common stock of Trak Auto Corp and Crown Books Corp .
Dart said it will pay Robert, Gloria and Linda Haft a total of about $41 million in connection with these transactions.

The company said the agreement also contemplates the completion of bankruptcy plans of reorganization for the partnerships owning Dart's headquarters building in Landover, Md., and a warehouse leased by Dart's subsidiary, Trak Auto, in Bridgeview, Ill.

Under the bankruptcy plans, the company will pay a total of $4.4 million, 50 percent of which would be offset by the release to Dart of funds previously escrowed for Ronald Haft, to Robert and Linda Haft for their interests in these two partnerships, and a total of $7 million to reduce outstanding institutional mortgage loans on these properties.
The properties would thereafter be wholly-owned by Dart affiliates.
